full_prompt_en: The image is a square, finely worked symbolic painting of a winged woman shown from the chest upward in right-facing profile. Her pale face is sharply defined against a large rust-red circular disk behind the head. The eye looks to the right beyond the frame, and the straight nose, small parted lips, and elongated neck establish a calm, intent expression. Warm brown hair lies close to her head before falling behind the shoulder. A broad pale wing begins near the back of her head and sweeps diagonally toward the lower left corner. Its many long feathers are individually separated by thin lines, with cream, muted gold, green, and soft salmon tones woven together. The wing is large enough to counterbalance the face while still leaving the facial silhouette completely clear. She wears a deep green garment whose surface carries darker, densely worked ornamental marks. A narrow light strip descends along the front of the garment. The circular disk has concentric bands, fine radial marks, and a subtly distressed surface; it is a flat graphic structure as much as a suggestion of light. Behind the disk, dark green plant forms and vertical stems fill the remaining space. These forms overlap closely, so the background reads as a decorative thicket rather than distant open scenery. The paint surface is slightly worn and granular, with small variations inside every colored field. Outlines remain precise, but the feather and leaf interiors are built from patient linear detail. No strong cast shadow or modern spotlight shapes the scene. The warm disk, pale wing, and face emerge from the dark cool foliage through color contrast and careful layering. The composition is still and ceremonial, with the disk anchoring the head, the wing creating a leftward sweep, and the dense vegetation giving the figure an enclosed, patterned setting.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、细密绘制的象征主义画作，一位有翼女子从胸部以上呈向右的侧面。苍白的脸在头后大片锈红圆盘前轮廓分明。她的眼望向画外右方，笔直的鼻、小而微启的唇和修长颈部构成平静而专注的神情。暖褐色头发贴近头部，再垂到肩后。一片宽阔浅色翅膀从脑后附近起始，斜斜扫向左下角。许多长羽由细线逐片分开，奶油色、暗金色、绿色和柔和鲑红色交织其中。翅膀足以平衡面部，却没有遮住清楚的脸部剪影。她身穿深绿衣服，表面布满更暗、更密的装饰痕迹。一条狭窄浅色衣边沿前襟垂下。圆盘有同心环带、细小放射纹和轻微磨损的表面，既暗示光环，也是平面的图形结构。圆盘背后，深绿色植物形状与竖向茎叶填满余下空间。这些形状紧密重叠，背景更像装饰性的密丛，而非开阔远景。颜料表面略显陈旧且带颗粒，每块色域内部都有细微变化。轮廓精确，而羽毛和叶片的内部由耐心的线性细节构成。场景没有强投影或现代聚光灯。暖色圆盘、浅色翅膀与脸通过颜色对比和细致叠层从深冷的叶丛中显现。构图静止且具有仪式感：圆盘锚定头部，翅膀向左展开，密植被给人物一个封闭而图案化的环境。
style_prompt_en: A finely layered symbolic painting uses precise profiles, large circular geometry, and densely patterned natural forms. Aged rust, muted gold, cream, and deep green form a restrained warm-cool contrast. Thin drawn contours distinguish many small overlapping elements, while their interiors carry delicate featherlike or leaflike strokes. Color fields remain granular and lightly distressed rather than perfectly flat. Broad shapes organize the frame first; intricate linework rewards closer attention without breaking the calm silhouette. Light is conveyed mainly through pale surfaces placed against dark patterned ground, not through theatrical cast shadows. The resulting atmosphere is still, ornate, and slightly antique, with decorative rhythm and patient surface detail carrying the visual character.
style_prompt_zh: 这种细致叠绘的象征性绘画运用准确的侧面轮廓、大片圆形几何和密集图案化的自然形态。陈旧锈红、暗金、奶油色与深绿形成克制的冷暖对照。细线轮廓分隔许多重叠的小元素，内部带有羽片或叶片般的精细笔痕。色块保有颗粒和轻微磨损，而非完全平滑。大片形状先组织画幅，繁复线工在近看时显现，却不破坏宁静的剪影。明亮感主要来自浅色表面与深色图案底的并置，而非戏剧性投影。整体静止、华美、略带古意，以装饰节奏和耐心经营的表面细节形成视觉性格。
theme_en: A winged woman in profile before a rust-colored circular halo
theme_zh: 一位侧面的有翼女子立于锈红色圆形光环前
name: Jean Delville
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
